newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real up 0.08 pct in calm post-holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real up 0.08 pct in calm post-holiday trade.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.08 percent to close at 1.0386 against the dollar in calm post-holiday trading due to dollar inflows in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
In the afternoon the central bank bought dollars at 1.0385 reais per greenback to drain excess dollars from the market.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Thursday surplus of $180 million.
Dealers said they expect another calm trade session on Friday, anticipating no new move by the central bank before next week.

The central bank last lowered the real-dollar mini-band on Monday. So far this month, the central bank has lowered the mini-band 0.58 percent and dealers were not sure if the bank would depreciate the mini-band again before the end of the year.
In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0442 to the dollar, up 0.01 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real closed steady at 1.125 per greenback.
